title: AO-MA-11A Plan Consensus Bundle
description: Plan-time, multi-provider consensus bundle for the autonomous multi-AI coding workflow. AIs (anthropic+openai+minimax) review a proposed plan in rounds; this bundle aggregates their latest-round verdicts into a single unanimous_status. ONLY when unanimous_status == 'AGREE' may a plan-approval artifact (ao-ma-11a-plan-approval.v1) be requested at the single operator gate. This is the PLAN-TIME analog of the merge-time per-provider record (ao-ma-10-provider-consensus.v1): it reuses the same verdict vocabulary and a 3-AI subset of the provider_id vocabulary but binds to a plan (plan_digest + base) rather than a PR diff. Evidence only; release authority remains ao-release-gate plus the GitHub ruleset; AI consensus is NOT release authority. unanimous_status is machine-recomputed from provider_verdicts at validation time (no self-attestation).

consensus_id.description: Stable consensus identifier: ao-ma-plan-YYYYMMDD-<6 lowercase alnum>.

operator_goal.description: The operator goal the AIs planned for (free text, no secrets).

plan_digest.description: SHA-256 of the agreed plan document the verdicts refer to.

acceptance_criteria.description: Machine- or human-checkable definition of done for the planned work.

required_providers.description: Exactly the three providers that must reach AGREE for unanimity: anthropic, openai, minimax.

provider_verdicts.description: Per-provider, per-round verdicts for the mandated 3-AI quorum. Must contain at least one entry for each of anthropic, openai and minimax; the latest round per provider drives unanimity. Round indices must be contiguous (1..max) and bound to round_budget by the validator.

round_budget.description: Maximum number of consensus rounds before escalation to the operator (matches the merge-lane max of 3).

rounds_used.description: Number of rounds actually used; must be <= round_budget (enforced by the validator).

unanimous_status.description: Aggregate consensus outcome. AGREE iff every required provider's latest-round verdict is AGREE. Machine-recomputed from provider_verdicts at validation time; a stored value that disagrees with the recomputation is rejected fail-closed.

provider_id.description: Plan-time quorum providers; a 3-AI subset of the merge-time ao-ma-10 provider_id vocabulary (no extra/advisory providers in the plan bundle).

objections.description: Recorded objections for this verdict (empty array when AGREE with no objections).

spm_profile_ref.description: Path/ref to the SPM quality profile (formalized in AO-MA-11G). May be a forward placeholder until 11G lands.

tracking_refs.description: GitHub milestone/issue/project refs (AO-MA-11E mirror). Empty array until 11E wiring lands.
